decisions.rationale: The disease name spinocerebellar ataxia type 3 is used in the title to modify the noun gene (rat ... gene), so it is annotated as a Modifier rather than a standalone disease.
decisions.guideline_section: 3. Annotate disease mentions that are used as Modifiers for other concepts

decisions.rationale: Machado-Joseph disease is a single, specifically defined disease name with no further categorization.
MJD is the abbreviation of Machado-Joseph disease and is annotated as a separate synonymous mention referring to the same specific disease.
neurodegenerative disorders refers to a family of multiple clinically and genetically heterogeneous diseases, so it is a Disease Class.
decisions.guideline_section: 1. Annotate all Specific Disease mentions (Disease Class definition) and Examples 11 (grey area terms as Disease Class)

decisions.rationale: progressive cerebellar ataxia is a clinical description that may encompass multiple ataxic conditions and does not map to one specific disease definition, so it is a grey-area Disease Class mention.
decisions.guideline_section: 1. Disease Class definition and Examples 11 (grey area terms annotated as Disease Class if appropriate)

decisions.rationale: MJD1 here names a gene (repeat expansions in the MJD1 gene), not a disease, so it is not a disease mention.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate section 1 (only disease mentions are annotated; gene symbols are not disease names)

decisions.rationale: autosomal dominant spinocerebellar ataxia type 3 refers to one specific disease (SCA3) and is annotated as the full minimal span of the most specific form.
decisions.guideline_section: 1. Annotate all Specific Disease mentions and 5. Annotate minimum necessary span of text

decisions.rationale: SCA3 in parentheses is the abbreviation of the specific disease in the preceding mention and is annotated as a separate synonymous mention.
MJD1 in the phrase MJD1 / SCA3 gene refers to the gene locus, not to a disease.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate section 1 (only disease mentions are annotated; gene symbols are not disease names)

decisions.rationale: SCA3 in the phrase MJD1 / SCA3 gene refers to the gene, not to the disease, so it is not annotated.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate section 1 (only disease mentions are annotated; gene symbols are not disease names)

decisions.rationale: SCA3 in the expression pattern of the SCA3 gene refers to the gene being studied in tissues, not to a disease.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate section 1 (only disease mentions are annotated; gene symbols are not disease names)

decisions.rationale: rsca3 is the rat gene transcript name for the gene, not a disease mention.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate section 1 (only disease mentions are annotated; gene symbols are not disease names)

decisions.rationale: SCA3 gene in the brain-section expression analysis refers to the gene and its mRNA level, not to the disease.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate section 1 (only disease mentions are annotated; gene symbols are not disease names)

decisions.rationale: MJD in regions predominantly affected in MJD refers to the disease Machado-Joseph disease, an abbreviation of the specific disease.
